Guava pastelitos.d: Puff pastry sealed around guava paste and cream cheese, baked golden and brushed with sugar syrup.
Guava pastelitos.note: Out of the oven every hour.

Gold token cookies.d: Butter shortbread rounds the size of a subway fare, the middle punched out, the tops brushed with gold.
Gold token cookies.note: Good for a cookie. Not a ride.

Token booth honey roasted nuts.d: Almonds, cashews and peanuts tossed in honey, sugar, cinnamon and a pinch of salt, baked and stirred till glossy. Sold warm in a paper cone.

Arroz con pollo.d: Chicken thighs browned hard, then set on long-grain rice cooked slow with onion, green pepper, garlic, cilantro, achiote, green olives and capers.

Money Train payday michelada.d: Cold lager over ice with fresh lime, tomato juice, hot sauce and a dash of Worcestershire, in a glass rimmed with chili salt, slipped into a paper sack.
